відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"A structured navy blue blouse with a subtle sheen, cut in a classic fit-and-flare silhouette to elongate the torso and ending at the high hip for ease of movement, crafted from lightweight ponte knit to maintain a polished shape throughout the interview. High-waisted pleated trousers in matching charcoal wool blend, offering a fluid drape from waist to ankle with a mid-calf length that avoids constriction while maintaining a sharp silhouette suitable for standing during the assessment. Flat leather loafers in a deep brown hue, constructed with a minimal heel and rounded toe to ensure comfort during the walk-and-talk portions of the conversation while projecting a grounded and reliable demeanor. A delicate gold-tone necklace with a small geometric pendant, adding a touch of warmth that complements her skin tone without appearing overpowering for a corporate setting. This outfit works perfectly because the navy blouse paired with charcoal trousers creates a sophisticated monochrome base that signals competence and seriousness appropriate for a banking environment. The tailored blazer adds the necessary layer of formality required for an interview while the pleats and mid-calf length ensure comfort during periods of standing.
